title: Tatooine Sand Beast
subtitle: Creature
description: The Tattoine Sand Beast was a massive, six-limbed reptilian creature that could use its limbs as hands or feet, depending on the situation. To keep cool in the desert heat, they can burrow beneath the sand. When Tusken Raiders captured Boba Fett, he and his fellow prisoner encountered one accidentally, but it was no match for BobaFett
